s.zh: 上古脑吞下了夺心魔的尸体，苏醒过来。
s.en: The elder brain swallowed the mind flayer's corpse and awoke.

s.zh: 上古脑吸收了足够多的大脑，成长到
s.en: The elder brain has absorbed enough brains to grow to level

s.zh: \n\n它开始用心灵呼唤远方的流浪者。
s.en: \n\nIt begins calling to distant wanderers psychically.

s.zh: 上古脑断粮挨饿了一天
s.en: The elder brain went hungry for a day without food
. Feed it herbal medicine, raw meat or meals.

s.zh: 上古脑产出了一条夺心魔蝌蚪。
s.en: The elder brain produced a mind flayer tadpole.

s.zh: 上古脑用心灵呼唤了一个流浪者：
s.en: The elder brain called a wanderer psychically:

s.zh: 正恍惚地走向它，到达后会倒在旁边。
s.en: is walking toward it in a daze, and will collapse beside it on arrival.

s.zh: 上古脑被摧毁了。群脑的核心断裂，所有夺心魔都受到了心灵反噬：心情大降，脑髓流失。
s.en: The elder brain has been destroyed. The core of the hive mind snapped, and all mind flayers suffered psychic backlash: mood plummets, brain matter drains.

s.zh: 把一具夺心魔尸体放在上古脑旁边（相邻格子），上古脑会吞下它并苏醒。
s.en: Place a mind flayer corpse next to the elder brain (adjacent cell), and the elder brain will swallow it and awaken.

s.zh: 上古脑旁边没有夺心魔尸体。
s.en: There's no mind flayer corpse next to the elder brain.

s.zh: 把一份传承记忆灌装成脑浆罐。夺心魔使用脑浆罐会继承其中80%的经验。上古脑最多保存5份记忆。
s.en: Fill one inherited memory into a brain jar. A mind flayer using the brain jar inherits 80% of the XP in it. The elder brain stores at most 5 memories.

s.zh: 沉睡中：把一具夺心魔尸体放在旁边唤醒它。
s.en: Dormant: place a mind flayer corpse next to it to awaken it.

s.zh: 挨饿中：停止产出蝌蚪，每天丢失一份记忆
s.en: Starving: stops producing tadpoles, loses one memory per day

s.zh: 只有夺心魔能吸收传承记忆
s.en: Only mind flayers can absorb inherited memories
